subject: surgery
title: Flexible Stone Surgery, Stents and Expulsive Therapy

steps.tx: Flexible scope surgery performed backwards up the ureter into the kidney is **RIRS**. Retrograde intrarenal surgery uses a bendable scope and laser to dust kidney stones without any skin cut. It suits stones that shock waves cannot clear. It suits stones up to about 2 centimetres, especially lower pole stones whose shock wave fragments cannot drain uphill by gravity.
steps.say: Retrograde intrarenal surgery threads a bendable scope into the kidney and lasers stones without any skin cut.

vis.alt: Endoscopic and shock wave options for kidney stones.
vis.caption: Flexible endoscopic stone surgery inside the kidney. [Credit: StewardMD]

steps.tx: A soft tube left inside the ureter with coils at both ends is a **DJ stent**. The double J stent keeps urine flowing past swelling or fragments after stone surgery. It is removed weeks later with a telescope through the bladder. Forgotten stents encrust with stone and may need several operations to remove, so every stent needs a planned removal date.
steps.say: A double J stent keeps urine flowing after stone surgery and comes out weeks later through the bladder.

steps.tx: Drug treatment that helps a small ureteric stone pass on its own is **medical expulsive therapy**. It combines pain relief, fluids and sometimes a relaxing drug for the ureter. Most stones under five millimetres pass without any procedure. Most stones under 5 millimetres pass within four weeks, while stones over 10 millimetres rarely pass without a procedure.
steps.say: Medical expulsive therapy helps small stones pass with pain relief and fluids, and most tiny stones pass alone.

steps.tx: The alpha blocker most used to relax the lower ureter and help stones pass is **tamsulosin**. By easing ureteric spasm it can shorten the time to stone passage. It may cause light headedness when standing quickly. Benefit is clearest for lower ureteric stones near the bladder and doubtful for tiny stones already likely to pass alone.
steps.say: Tamsulosin relaxes the lower ureter to help stones pass, though it can cause light headedness on standing.

vis.alt: Alpha blocker mechanism relaxing smooth muscle.
vis.caption: Alpha blockers relax ureteric smooth muscle. [Credit: StewardMD]

steps.tx: A stone forming inside the bladder itself is a **vesical calculus**. Bladder stones usually follow poor emptying from prostate enlargement or a foreign body. They cause frequency, interrupted stream and blood at the end of urination. Blood at the very end of the stream, called terminal haematuria, localises the source to the bladder neck or prostate.
steps.say: A vesical calculus forms inside a poorly emptying bladder and causes frequency with an interrupted stream.

steps.tx: Open removal of a large bladder stone through a suprapubic cut is **cystolithotomy**. Most bladder stones today are crushed endoscopically instead. The cause of poor emptying, often the prostate, must also be treated or stones return. Treating the blocked outlet at the same time, usually by prostate resection, prevents the high recurrence after stone removal alone.
steps.say: Cystolithotomy removes large bladder stones openly, but the cause of poor emptying must also be treated.

steps.tx: A kidney swollen with urine because its outflow is blocked shows **hydronephrosis**. Ultrasound first shows the stretched collecting system. Long standing obstruction thins the kidney tissue and reduces function. Urine output often stays normal because the healthy kidney compensates, while the blocked side silently loses function over weeks.
steps.say: Hydronephrosis means a kidney swollen with trapped urine, and long obstruction thins its tissue.

vis.caption: Hydronephrosis: swollen kidney from blocked outflow. [Credit: StewardMD]

steps.tx: Fever in a patient with an obstructed kidney signals an **obstructed infected kidney**. This combination can progress to severe sepsis within hours. Urgent drainage plus antibiotics takes priority over definitive stone removal. Blood cultures and antibiotics come first, but drainage by stent or nephrostomy within hours is what actually controls the sepsis.
steps.say: Fever with an obstructed kidney can become severe sepsis within hours, so urgent drainage comes first.

steps.tx: Pain relief for ureteric colic works best with anti inflammatory drugs, a principle called **stepwise analgesia**. These drugs reduce ureteric spasm and pressure as well as pain. Opioids are reserved for pain that simpler drugs cannot control. Non steroidal drugs are first line unless kidney function is poor or bleeding risk is high, when opioids take over.
steps.say: Anti inflammatory drugs relieve colic best by reducing ureteric pressure, with opioids kept in reserve.
